subject: Sapphire Health renewal — bakeoff request and proposed save offer
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@brightwell.health>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@brightwell.health>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal window + incoming bakeoff from NimbusAI

Hi Lauren,

Quick note — as we approach our May 1 renewal, the procurement team has flagged an active bakeoff request from NimbusAI. They say they can match our feature set at lower cost and have provided a provisional proof-of-concept plan.

Primary asks from our side: a short throughput/latency benchmark with our sample workload, SOC 2 evidence for our compliance review, and a clear renewal term outline if we stay with Redwood.

Can you run a perf-run and share a concise save offer this week? Procurement is pushing for options.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Director of Platform Engineering
Brightwell Health
[Attachment: contract_summary_from_nimbus.pdf (pdf)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightwell.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + incoming bakeoff from NimbusAI

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the Nimbus deck.

We can run a focused bakeoff and provide SOC 2 artefacts. Proposed next steps:
- Live performance run using your sample workload (30–45 min) — can do Tue 4/13 or Wed 4/14.
- We will provide a one-page save offer with term pricing, a short Dedicated trial option, and a measurable SLA uplift.
- I'll loop in our solutions lead (Karthik) and Customer Success (Marissa) to coordinate logistics.

Please send the exact sample payload and any p95 targets you want us to validate. Attaching a quick quote/term primer so you have something to share internally.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_quick_quote_v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal window + incoming bakeoff from NimbusAI — quick internal plan

Team — forwarding Elena's note below. High level plan to defend and save the renewal:

Objectives
- Win on measurable performance and operational guarantees (latency p95, token cost).
- Offer a low-friction Dedicated trial + 10% renewal discount and 30-day credit to blunt price objection.
- Provide SOC 2 docs and a succinct implementation checklist for Brightwell's security team.

Owners & timings
- Karthik: lead perf run (set up model variant, KV warmup script, collect p95/p99 traces). Deadline: 4/13 EOD for initial report.
- Marissa: coordinate trial logistics (Dedicated pool access, billing workstream, pilot success criteria).
- Connor: prepare a short Ops note about migration rollback/fallback for legal/procurement — include standard indemnities and transition assistance.
- Naomi: prepare a 1-page financials summary mapping current TCO vs proposed to support the renewal ask.

Price posture
- Baseline: 10% off renewal MRC if they commit to 12 months.
- Escalator: additional 5% if they sign before 4/30 and agree to a 6-week performance pilot on Dedicated nodes.

Attachments to draft: save_offer_summary.pdf (to send after the live run), throughput_report_stub.csv (for the perf run). Keep comms tight; procurement will escalate quickly.

— Lauren

From: Elena Morales <elena@brightwell.health>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@brightwell.health>
Date: 2027-04-12T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + incoming bakeoff from NimbusAI

Lauren / Karthik — confirmed, Tue 4/13 at 10:00 PST works for the live run. I've attached a sample_workload.json (50k short prompts, mix of embeddings and generation calls) and a short procurement checklist. Key notes from our security team: ensure KV-cache warmup is demonstrated and include any quantization notes (we run a lot of short-turnaround inference).

Also, if you can share a sandbox key that lets us validate tokens consumed with our observability tooling that would help procurement feel comfortable.

Thanks — appreciate the rapid response.
Elena
[Attachment: sample_workload.json (json), procurement_checklist.docx (docx)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightwell.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + incoming bakeoff from NimbusAI — save offer and commitments

Elena — great session today. Summary and next steps below.

What we demonstrated
- 30-minute live perf run on your sample workload (attached throughput CSV) with KV warmup script. p95 latency: 92 ms; token cost delta vs Nimbus sample: -12% at equivalent QoE settings.
- Provided SOC 2 Type II report and compliance checklist to your security lead.

Save offer (concise)
- 12-month renewal at 10% off current MRC.
- 30-day Dedicated trial at no additional charge (trial terms in save_offer_summary.pdf).
- One-time onboarding credit equal to 1 month of current spend if they sign by 2027-04-30.
- Commitment to a week-on/week-off rollback plan and a fallback variant for the first 60 days post-renewal.

Attachments & links
- save_offer_summary.pdf (summary of pricing and trial)
- throughput_report_stub.csv (perf run results)
- SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf (delivered to security separately)
- HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/contacts/CS-81234

Next steps
1) Elena to share final procurement feedback.
2) If procurement accepts terms, we'll route draft order form and legal redlines by 4/15.
3) Marissa to set up Dedicated trial environment and success metrics.

If procurement escalates, we'll loop in VP Sales — but the combination of Dedicated trial + credit should blunt the price-first argument.

Thanks again —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: save_offer_summary.pdf (pdf)]
